title: Glucose Measurement Protocol
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yj9fur6

steps.title: Prepare 2X Reagent Solution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the powdered reagent using 25 ml of distilled water to create a 2X solution.

steps.title: Add Calibrator and Samples
steps.instruction: Dispense 3 μl of calibrator and sample into each respective well.

steps.title: Perform Initial Reading
steps.instruction: Add 150 μl of PBS to each well and read the absorbance at 540 nm.

substeps.instruction: Ensure no bubbles are added to the wells during reagent dispensing to avoid interference with the plate reader.

steps.title: Incubate and Final Reading
steps.instruction: Add 150 μl of the prepared 2X reagent to each well, incubate at 37°C for 10 minutes, and read the absorbance at 540 nm.

steps.title: Calculate Glucose Concentration
steps.instruction: Subtract blank readings from final readings and calculate unknown samples using the linear assay formula.

substeps.instruction: Calculate as: (Sample Absorbance ÷ Calibrator Absorbance) × Calibrator Concentration
